title: Verity
name: VERITY
description: Deterministic multi-modal deepfake examination platform for image, video, and audio. Characterizes media, selects evidence-grade detectors, runs each in an isolated version-pinned environment, and preserves per-detector verdicts, reasoning, and explainability artifacts without collapsing disagreement into a single score.
highlights: 58 ported detector architectures (39 evidence-grade) in isolated uv environments + 5 model-free forensic analyzers
Standalone air-gapped Linux executable with embedded FastAPI/React console and USB air-gap export/import kits
Deterministic chain-of-custody .zip evidence bundles (MANIFEST.json + SHA256SUMS.txt) and Hugging Face checkpoint mirror

title: DroidScanner
name: DROIDSCANNER
description: 100% offline Android security auditor with zero INTERNET permission enforced at the OS sandbox level. Audits installed apps, pre-install APKs, and device posture through public rootless APIs with explainable risk scoring and continuous background monitoring.
highlights: Scoring Engine v3 (~380 permissions across 9 domains, 19 combination rules) + streaming low-RAM Deep APK/DEX inspection
Pre-Install APK Scanner with signing-certificate mismatch detection, 16 rootless device posture checks, and WorkManager Background Guard
Auto-invalidating Reviewed & Trusted workflow, bounded on-device MediaPipe Sentence Encoder, and shareable PDF/JSON reports

title: Sempropos
name: SEMPROPOS
tagline: offline-first semantic cli replacement for man & apropos
description: Instant, offline-first Linux CLI (sem) that indexes locally installed commands into a canonical ToolSpec database for plain-English command synthesis (Ctrl+S), 0ms-LLM structured reference cards, and ranked tool discovery.
highlights: 4-source ToolSpec pipeline (man(7)/mdoc(7) macro parser, tldr-pages, Fish/Zsh completions, safe --help probe) in SQLite v3 + FTS5 + FastEmbed
Curated local GGUF models (0.5B–3B via llama.cpp), pure-HTTP Ollama/OpenAI providers, and Tier-0 deterministic mode
Warm Unix-domain-socket daemon (<200ms latency), Ctrl+S shell widget, and command grounding with destructive safety warnings

title: ChronoTrace
name: CHRONOTRACE
description: Forensic analysis framework for uncovering timestamp manipulation and log evasion on Windows NTFS volumes through both post-mortem EnCase .E01 disk image analysis and real-time live system monitoring.
highlights: Parses $MFT, $UsnJrnl, and $LogFile structures via libewf/pyewf and correlates $SI vs $FN timestamps
15 deterministic anti-forensics rules detecting backdating, LSN sequence breaks, USN gaps, and stripped Mark-of-the-Web ADS
Real-time WebSocket progress/alert streaming, interactive case timeline viewer, and exportable PDF forensic reports

title: ADBSight
name: ADBSIGHT
description: Cross-platform Rust + Ratatui terminal inspector for Android devices over USB and Wi-Fi ADB. Evolved from the earlier .NET WinForms ADB Data Fetcher into a fast, zero-setup TUI with live telemetry, offline SQLite snapshots, and multi-format dossier exports.
highlights: First-class Wi-Fi Wireless Debugging: Android 11+ terminal Unicode QR pairing, mDNS auto-discovery, and one-key USB-to-Wi-Fi handoff
8 deep inspector modules: live CPU/Wi-Fi sparklines, dumpsys/settings, processes, packages, streaming logcat, dual-pane files, personal data, and shell
Root-aware unlock, bundled WAL-mode SQLite snapshot history, JSON/CSV/Markdown exports, and built-in --demo device simulator

title: Gloss
name: GLOSS
description: Everyday offline Android translation reader built for instant phrase lookup and word-level comprehension anywhere—no mobile data, account, or cloud dependency required.
highlights: 202 languages 100% offline via quantized Meta AI NLLB-200-distilled-600M INT8 ONNX (~1.4 GB peak RAM)
Bidirectional Duolingo-style tap-a-word lookup on both source and translated text, plus Quick Translate & Recent Phrases home screen widgets
Offline Android TTS pronunciation, searchable FLORES-200 language picker, pinned Hugging Face mirror, and in-app GitHub Releases / Obtainium updates

title: Wordsmith
name: WORDSMITH
description: Zero-config npm CLI using a local ONNX zero-shot NER model (GLiNER) and probability-ranked mutation tiers to generate targeted password wordlists from raw OSINT text.

title: qr-transfer
name: QR-TRANSFER
tagline: air-gapped file transfer over qr codes
description: Terminal file transfer utility between two laptops using QR codes and webcams as the physical channel, implementing stop-and-wait ARQ with sequence numbers and SHA-256 verification.

title: MerkleWatch
name: MERKLEWATCH
description: CLI utility that generates deterministic SHA-256 Merkle-tree directory snapshots with .merkleignore support to detect file tampering, additions, and removals.

title: Inquiro
name: INQUIRO
description: Local-first RAG system transforming PDF and DOCX collections into a queryable knowledge base using LangChain, FAISS, and Ollama.

title: TeleDM
name: TELEDM
description: Standalone Tkinter desktop download manager with Telegram API integration, interrupt-tolerant resume, queue management, and SQLite persistent history.
